title: Sagan whispers 'keep up the great work' to Hoagland

tellings.quote: apparently came up to him and put his hand on his shoulder and said, "Keep up the great work." Like whispered into his ear and then uh walked off.

plain: The astronomer Carl Sagan is said to have walked up to Richard Hoagland, a man known for claims about NASA and the Moon, at a hearing. Sagan put a hand on his shoulder, whispered "Keep up the great work" in his ear and walked off. A guest named Maaneli Derakhshani tells this second-hand, as something Hoagland told him, and it would suggest that Sagan quietly backed work he did not support in public.
